profile.headline: Junior Software Developer | Active Security Clearance | CompTIA Security+ Certified | CompTIA A+ Certified
profile.summary:
Active Secret Clearance, IT professional skilled in Windows, Office 365, Active Directory, Outlook 2016, problem solving, and troubleshooting hardware/software

- Hard selfless worker that's easy to get along with however focus on accomplishing the task on hand
- Motivated learner that taught myself the Android programming language and has published two applications to the play store

positions.title: Junior Software Developer/Data Analyst
positions.description:
• Oversaw the maintenance of Circuit Information Management Toolset (CIMTS) and the Navy Network
Information Center website along with their respective database’s
• Developed a report named DISN Bandwidth that is automated in the CIMTS website from raw data in
Excel using .NET Framework which cut down the report creation time from a 45 minute process to a 2
minute process
• Created a Financial Dashboard link that holds two Jtables displaying circuits that have been discontinued with no action on them for at least 45 days and circuits that are potential for double billing
• Created a link that holds a Jtable where when the DISN bandwidth report is updated each month the user
will see the circuits that are new and the circuits that are discontinued.
• Fixed code to upload the monthly Tseas Inventory Billing Information (TIBI) Report
• Implement .NET coding solutions for bugs found within CIMTS website
• Implement .NET coding solutions for bugs found within NNIC website

positions.title: Application System Analyst II
positions.description:
•	Provided Tier 3 back end support of the Ordnance Information System (OIS) software application used by weapon stations around the worlds and over 150 ships in the United States Fleet Forces, resolving over 220 issues per month, which allows the Navy to stay up to date in defending the United States
•	Self-taught Visual Basic code to program an update to existing code for a macro in excel 2016 
•	Enabled DOD end users OIS accounts through Oracle Identity Management system
•	Provided proper documentation to potential DOD end users to gain access OIS
•	Taught perspective users the OIS application and account usage process
•	Updated and sent out SQL CLOB (Character Large Object) scripts to ships to run and clear OIS errors
•	Ran SQL queries to troubleshoot data entry issues and submit solution queries to the DBA’s through Azdure Devops in a Work Item

positions.title: Service Desk Agent
positions.description:
•	Helping the Department of Defense and our military defend our country by providing technical support services on the Navy Marine Corps Intranet (NMCI) network
•	Providing 1st level administrative software support and hardware support diagnosis to essential personnel
•	Effectively identify and escalate situations to the proper hardware and software team when 1st level resolution does not resolve issue
•	Enable and unlock user’s accounts through Active Directory
•	Map shared drives for and printers to users to help mitigate downtime from work production
•	Troubleshoot onsite and remote connectivity to end users so connection interruption is maintained at a low rate
•	Effectively assisted users in getting connected to the NMCI when teleworking VPN

positions.title: GOCard Technician
positions.description:
•	Provided technical support to over 45 buildings where the University ID’s (GOCards) are being used 
•	Installed updated GOCard door readers throughout the University to provide maximum and efficient safety for the students and faculty
•	Troubleshoot, diagnosed, repaired or escalated GOCard door reader issues within 24 hours of first notification of issue 
•	Cleaned and organized the storage room to have easy access to hardware when needed
•	Organized vendor repair on door readers after diagnosing issue cannot be repaired by GOCard team

positions.title: IT Inventory Technician
positions.description:
•	Was tasked with organizing the return of older IT equipment for recycling
•	Helped maintain computerized record of IT equipment
•	Collaborated with the inventory team to delegate and simplify the inventory process

•	Install and configure hardware for new employees PC’s and employees upgrading their

positions.title: Desktop Support Agent
positions.description:
Desktop Support Agent August 2017-Present
Hemmersbach (contract through TEKsystems) Dearborn, MI
Effectively provide tier 2 support both on site and remotely to WPP subsidiaries companies in North America.  Identify and escalate tickets with the to the proper tier team through ServiceNow Ticketing systems.  Duties Include:
•	Map shared drives and printers for users so they can gain access and print business documents
•	Install and upgrade critical software applications for the user to effectively perform at a high level
•	Add users to different account groups to gain access to different software
•	Guide users in getting access to the company VPN
•	Install and configure hardware on PC’s for business needs
•	Log all necessary information and detail for every ticket that is opened

positions.title: Android Developer
positions.description:
GPA Calculator:
●	Developed and designed this user friendly mobile application for college students to know precisely what their overall gpa will be if they achieve their semester gpa goal.
●     Solicited voice of customer via end user testing of college students
GGATip calculator:
●	Conceptualized, designed and developed a user friendly mobile tip calculator application that calculates what would be a good, great, and awesome tip based off the amount your bill is 
●	Researched application acceptance and solicited feedback from users to understand target audience needs
●	Tested application on various current Android IOS devices such as Samsung S5 with version 5.1.1  to identify errors

positions.title: Service Desk Agent
positions.description:
Provide effective 1st level resolution technical support to the University of Michigan Medical School and Hospital students and staff by diagnosing and correcting problems.  Effectively escalate tickets to the proper Tier team through Remedy and Zendesk Ticketing systems when 1st level solutions are not available. Duties include:
•	Reset users passwords within the Identity Management system
•	Rebuild users Microsoft Outlook profiles so they regain access to their Outlook account
•	Map shared drives for users so they can gain access to critical business documents
•	Set up users for University’s two factor authentication with the DUO application to comply with HIPPA standards
•	Troubleshoot internet connectivity and operating system connection issues with users
•	Effectively assisted users in getting connected to the University VPN
•	Install and configure hardware on PC’s for business needs
•	Install and configure software applications on network PC’s
•	Improve knowledge base by finding solutions to issues that are not documented

positions.title: IT Consultant
positions.description:
●	Support 36 Salvation Army stores and rehabilitation centers in network connectivity, hardware installation and support
●	Log resolutions to support issues through online ticketing system
●	Install store media lines to run store commercials and music
●	Install windows PC’s to salvation army counselors and supervisors
●	Rebuild PC’s for backup usage
●      Upgraded POS memory which lead to efficient performance in POS systems
●	Troubleshoot network connectivity throughout main salvation army rehab center to maintain stable internet
●	Install and update company android devices that are given out to employees to maintain communication between the stores and departments

positions.title: Product Information Specialist
positions.description:
●	Provided help desk technical services support for millions of Canon customers in resolving software operating system problems as well as account and canon software connectivity issues. Installed drivers and software as well as troubleshoot canon software connectivity to enhance and assure proper operation of vast amount on Canon product suite
●	Effectively answer inbound calls from millions of customers in the United States in a professional and courteous manner that helped Canon receive two of its four 2014 MarketTools ACE (Achievement in Customer Excellence) Awards in the area of Service Exchange Satisfaction, Sales Support Satisfaction
●	Responsible for listening to customers attentively, answering questions, asking appropriate follow up questions and providing customers with the appropriate information for Canon products that assisted in Canon making over $40 million in sales in 2013
●	Documents customers’ calls into Canon call center help desk system to have a track of Canon’s millions of customers that allows Canon to present award winning customer service
●	Effectively provided level 1 support to customer's software and driver problems in Windows environment that helped Canon  receive one of its four 2014 MarketTools ACE (Achievement in Customer Excellence) awards in the area of Telephone Technical Support Satisfaction

positions.title: Computer Lab Assistant
positions.description:
Provided software and networking support as a Spartan Technician Intern for diverse faculty and students in a windows and mac environment while helping maintain their accounts. Duties include:
●      Assist in uploading software to Lab PC's using Deep Freeze Technology
●      Assist in imaging lab PC's
●	Provided technical support and  maintained over 6,500 users accounts using Active Directory to maintain fluidity amongst the University 
●	Provided courteous customer service and technical solutions to 6,500 diverse students using Microsoft 2013 products in a manner that allowed students to perform at a superior level with projects and assignments

positions.title: Assistant Lab Technician
positions.description:
Assistant Lab Technician, Office of Information Technology September 2010 – December 2012
Provided software and networking support as an Assistant Lab Technician for diverse faculty and students in a windows and mac environment while helping maintain their accounts. Duties include:
●	Provided technical support and  maintained over 6,500 users accounts using Active Directory to maintain fluidity amongst the University 
●	Provided courteous customer service and technical solutions to 6,500 diverse students using Microsoft 2010 products in a manner that allowed students to perform at a superior level with projects and assignments
●	Identified and configured faculty and students personal computer with Windows and Macintosh operating systems for internet connectivity that allowed easy accessibility to the University network for instructing and projects
●	Troubleshoot and repaired faculty and students personal computers with Windows and Macintosh operating systems for internet connectivity and media capability that allowed faculty to instruct, students to complete projects and assignments all at a superior level
●	Dispatched to various laboratories to troubleshoot and repair printers to maintain a functional environment for faculty and students
●	Trained various student technicians to troubleshoot and repair software connectivity problems with the faculty and student personal computers

company.name: Norfolk State University Office of Information Technology

positions.title: Information Technology Help Desk Intern
positions.description:
Provided technical and IT Help Desk support for over 4,500 end users on variety of issues by identifying, researching and resolving technical issues. Duties include:
●	Analyzed and resolved software/hardware problems for end user community 
●	Troubleshoot and repaired hardware/software problems to over 4,500 faculty and students personal computers with Windows and Macintosh operating systems to ensure high level of connectivity for instruction and assignments
●	Communicated, both orally and written, effective problems and solutions to faculty and students in a high volume environment that reduced recurrence of technical issues  
●	Recorded and maintained faculty and student repair files in accordance with office policy to ensure the up-to-date repair information
